shared_context.topic: differential diagnosis of right lower abdominal pain

snippets.output: Right lower abdominal pain in a 33-year-old female can be caused by various conditions.
snippets.notes: Framing statement that already encodes the patient context.

snippets.output: The differential diagnosis includes appendicitis, ovarian cyst, ectopic pregnancy, pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), and gastrointestinal issues.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of items in the same differential-diagnosis list (same subject).
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of differential diagnosis items (same subject).

snippets.output: Appendicitis is the inflammation of the appendix, often presenting with pain that starts near the navel and then shifts to the right lower abdomen.
snippets.notes: Definition plus characteristic presentation of appendicitis.
snippets.pattern_notes: Properties of appendicitis: definition plus characteristic presentation.

snippets.output: Symptoms of appendicitis may include nausea, vomiting, and fever.
An ovarian cyst is a fluid-filled sac on the ovary that can cause pain if it ruptures or becomes twisted (ovarian torsion).
snippets.pattern_notes: Definition plus conditional pain mechanisms as properties of ovarian cyst.

snippets.output: Symptoms of an ovarian cyst may include sudden, severe pain, nausea, and vomiting.
An ectopic pregnancy is a pregnancy that occurs outside the uterus, commonly in the fallopian tube.
snippets.pattern_notes: Properties of ectopic pregnancy: definition plus typical location.

snippets.output: Symptoms of an ectopic pregnancy include sharp, stabbing pain, vaginal bleeding, and dizziness.
Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is an infection of the female reproductive organs, often caused by sexually transmitted infections.
snippets.pattern_notes: Properties of PID: definition plus typical etiology.

snippets.output: Symptoms of pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) include pelvic pain, fever, and abnormal vaginal discharge.
Gastrointestinal issues such as Crohn's disease, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), or a hernia can cause right lower abdominal pain.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of GI causes of RLQ pain.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of GI causes of RLQ pain.

snippets.output: Symptoms of gastrointestinal issues vary depending on the specific condition.
A thorough clinical evaluation, including history and physical examination, is necessary to determine the exact cause of the pain.
snippets.notes: Conclusion (evaluation needed) with components of that evaluation.

snippets.output: A thorough clinical evaluation may include imaging studies such as ultrasound or CT scan.
